propositions: Plans make capability-surface assertions about named modules that can be false: module exists but lacks claimed capability, or capability exists but plan asserts it absent.
The E4 code-existence probe misses capability mismatches because it only verifies module presence, not the fine-grained capability surface (three verified misses: dc58, db7b, 5886).

A new advisory, agent-tier, code-grounded criterion 'asserted-capability' must be registered in the G6/E4 rubric family, plugged into the four-pass finder/verifier/decide/coach machinery, and must not block (advisory posture only).

The criterion requires registration entries (registry.py, criteria_routing.json), rubric prompt (plan_review_asserted_capability.md), regenerated guide section (plan-review-criteria-guide.md), and unit tests.
A bounded sanity check with 3 must-fire misses and 3 must-not-fire clean plans must demonstrate recall ≥2/3 on verified misses and non-blocking posture on false fires.
The criterion auto-integrates into the standing effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py) with zero per-criterion wiring, feeding the advisory→blocking promotion gate.
